rationale: No supported optimization is both applicable and safe for this workflow. The concurrency block already cancels in-progress/superseded runs for the same workflow and event (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE equivalent), so that optimization is already present. Dependency caching is already provided by setup-pixi with cache: true plus actions/cache for VisPy data (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE equivalent; an equivalent cache already exists, which is a listed contraindication). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (fail-fast: true on the build_0 matrix) is contraindicated because the coveralls job depends on build_0 and combines per-matrix coverage flags from every configuration, so every matrix outcome is required and canceling remaining jobs would reduce test coverage. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative per-job successful-duration history and risks breaking valid slow runs (the Prepare System Environment step already notes apt mirrors can exceed 2 hours). Schedule-based patterns (P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE) do not apply because the workflow has no schedule trigger, only push, pull_request, and workflow_dispatch.
